Chachamaru"No drama occurring, sir."
Hikaru"I see... So that is it."
Chachamaru"Princess?"
Hikaru"Late is late. The person who was late is at fault. Calling the teacher evil from a mere surface impression would be wrong."
Hikaru"Late, yet rescued unfairly from the proper punishment—that experience would surely cast an unfortunate shadow across her life. Kageaki considered even that..."
Hikaru"As expected, a different order from ordinary people. A man capable of drawing a clear boundary between kindness and coddling."
Chachamaru"Oooh. Then that student who appeared to have been abandoned was actually having her life saved by bhai's decision!"
Hikaru"Exactly!"
Chachamaru"Moving story, this."
Hikaru"A fine story indeed."
Chachamaru"And where did our actual investigation go?"
Hikaru"Somewhere else, apparently. No help for it. Another angle."

ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＣ"I dislike people who drift through life as you do."

ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＣ"Make a firmer effort to live properly, and set an example for the younger students."
Kageaki"Yes, ma'am!"
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＣ"What? Any complaint?"
Kageaki"None whatsoever."
